title: 大彰化離岸風電場
summary: 以遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈解析大彰化離岸風電場：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms through farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 和平民用發電與融合研究的公開熱循環、功能架構及工程證據。核能不包含燃料製備、濃縮、武器、反應性整定或反應爐操作；地熱、風電及水力不提供未經場址驗證的施工／操作參數。算例皆是假想，實機由合格專業團隊依規範負責。
scopeEn: Public thermal cycles, functional architecture and engineering evidence for peaceful generation/fusion research. Nuclear content excludes fuel production, enrichment, weapons, reactivity settings and reactor operations. Geothermal/wind/hydro supply no unverified construction/operation settings. Examples are hypothetical; qualified professionals govern actual equipment.
v30Focus: 臺灣最大的離岸風場：60 Hz 長距離輸出海纜、吸力桶基礎與企業購電合約
v30FocusEn: Taiwan's largest offshore wind farm: long 60 Hz export cables, suction-bucket foundations and a corporate power purchase agreement

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在大彰化離岸風電場案例中比較彰化風資源與typhoon與大型rotor與載荷，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate changhua resources/typhoons and large rotors/loads within the Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms case.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對彰化風資源與typhoon提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for changhua resources/typhoons.
steps.instruction: 在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識彰化風資源與typhoon。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify changhua resources/typhoons in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。
steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：額定MW乘8760h就是實際年發電量。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
steps.check: 提交彰化風資源與typhoon的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for changhua resources/typhoons.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 教學小型風輪假設ρ=1.225 kg/m³、面積100 m²、風速8 m/s、Cp=0.40，P=0.5ρAv³Cp=12.5440 kW。未含傳動電損、尾流、額定限值與風速分佈，不是本工程產品數值。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a teaching rotor with rho=1.225 kg/m³, A=100 m², v=8 m/s and Cp=0.40: P=12.5440 kW. Drivetrain/electrical loss, wakes, ratings and wind distributions are excluded; these are not project specifications.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「大彰化離岸風電場」的「風資源與功率包絡：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源輸入、轉換、儲存、輔助負載與有用輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「能源站：把損失算回來」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的能源表、儲能狀態、損失項及設備範圍的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Wind resources and power envelopes: architecture analysis” in “Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms”. Draw the energy input, conversion, storage, auxiliary loads and useful-output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Energy Station: Account for the Losses” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for same-window energy accounts, storage state, loss terms and equipment boundary, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for wind resources and power envelopes in changhua resources/typhoons?

Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.

steps.title: 風資源與功率包絡：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Wind resources and power envelopes: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對彰化風資源與typhoon提出可反駁的風資源與功率包絡模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable wind resources and power envelopes model and evidence record for changhua resources/typhoons.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「風資源與功率包絡」模型，檢查彰化風資源與typhoon的兩個假想案例。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous wind resources and power envelopes model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving changhua resources/typhoons. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.

steps.observationEn: Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Rated MW times 8760 hours equals actual annual generation.
steps.check: 提交彰化風資源與typhoon的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

steps.title: 葉片氣動與載荷：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Blade aerodynamics and loads: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對大型rotor與載荷提出可反駁的葉片氣動與載荷模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable blade aerodynamics and loads model and evidence record for large rotors/loads.
steps.instruction: 在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識大型rotor與載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify large rotors/loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。
steps.observationEn: Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：提升瞬時功率必然減輕所有結構載荷。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: More instantaneous power reduces every structural load.
steps.check: 提交大型rotor與載荷的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for large rotors/loads.
